overview.heading: Every customer conversation in one system
body: When calls, chat and messaging live in separate tools, customers wait and your team loses context. 3CX brings voice, video, WhatsApp, website chat and SMS into one platform, with queues, reporting and CRM integration built around it.
Your staff can answer from a desk phone, the desktop app or a mobile device. We choose the deployment, size the licence, connect the SIP trunk from your telecom operator and stay on for support.

faqs.q: Can we keep our existing phone numbers?
faqs.a: Your phone numbers and lines are provided by your licensed telecom operator, not by KHCOLO. In many cases your operator can connect them to 3CX through a SIP trunk. We work with your operator to confirm the approach and timing before anything is switched over.
3CX works with IP phones from vendors including Yealink, Cisco and Fanvil. We supply Yealink phones locally and can check whether equipment you already own can be reused.
3CX uses an annual licence sized by the number of simultaneous calls. Editions and included features change over time, so we confirm the current options in your quote.

name: SSL/TLS Certificates
summary: Certificate selection, validation, installation and renewal for websites and mail servers.
intro: TLS encrypts data travelling between your visitors and your server. We help you choose the right certificate, then handle the CSR, validation, installation and renewals for your websites and mail servers.

seo.title: SSL/TLS Certificates in Cambodia — KHCOLO
seo.description: SSL/TLS certificates for websites and mail servers: selection, CSR preparation, validation, installation, renewal and reissues, handled by KHCOLO.

highlights: Renewals and reissues tracked for you

overview.heading: Certificates without the admin
body: Certificates expire, validation emails get missed, and a badly installed chain can take a site or mail server offline. We manage the whole lifecycle so renewals happen before anything breaks.
A certificate protects data in transit. It's one important layer of web security, not a guarantee against every attack, so we'll also point out anything else worth fixing while we're there.

options.heading: Certificates we supply
rows: Typically issued in minutes; covers www and non-www; free reissues
Single, subdomain or wildcard coverage; RSA or ECC keys; TrulyTrust scan
Company identity in the certificate; dynamic site seal; unlimited server licensing; typically 1–3 days
options.note: Issuance times, features and warranty amounts are as stated by the certificate authorities and can change. Warranties are provided by the issuer under its own terms; we confirm current details before purchase.

process.title: Choose
process.body: Match validation level and coverage to the site or mail server.

process.title: Validate
process.body: Prepare the CSR and complete domain or business validation.

process.title: Install
process.body: Install the certificate and full chain, then test the connection.

process.title: Renew
process.body: Track expiry and handle renewals and reissues.

faqs.q: Will an SSL certificate stop my website being hacked?
faqs.a: No. TLS encrypts data in transit between the browser and your server. It's an important layer, but it doesn't fix vulnerable software or weak passwords, so combine it with updates, backups and endpoint protection.

faqs.q: What's the difference between domain and business validation?
faqs.a: Domain validation confirms you control the domain and is usually issued quickly. Business validation also verifies your company, and its details are included in the certificate. It takes longer, typically one to three days.
